title: Widening and Leveling of Existing concrete road and construction of parking platform at Dolphin's Nose Lighthouse cum DGPS Station.
summary: Re-invited e-tender for widening and levelling the existing concrete road and building a parking platform at Dolphin's Nose Lighthouse and DGPS Station, Yarada Hill, Visakhapatnam.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Port Residential Area, Saligramapuram, Visakhapatnam

sites.name: Dolphin's Nose Lighthouse cum DGPS Station, Post Box No. 134, Gandhigram Post Office, Yarada Hill, Visakhapatnam 530005
sites.work: Widening and levelling of existing concrete road; construction of parking platform

scope.item: Widening and Leveling of Existing concrete road

money.notes: Estimated cost including GST and all other taxes. EMD by DD/FDR/Bank Guarantee of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Visakhapatnam, valid three months from technical bid opening. EMD not exempted for any bidder (NSIC/MSME exemption withdrawn); EMD forfeited if timelines not followed.

period.completion: 02 months from the commencement of work
period.bid_validity: 120 days from date of opening of financial bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category & class with CPWD, State PWD, Railways, MES, BSNL or other State/Central Government/PSU/autonomous bodies
Similar works completed in last seven years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two each >= 50%, or one >= 80%; similar works = construction of cement concrete roads or other RCC works
PAN and GST registration; key technical personnel; unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure V); tender acceptance letter (Annexure IV)
Non-blacklisting affidavit; income tax returns for last three years; list of relatives serving in Ministry of Shipping or DGLL
Average annual turnover of last three financial years at least 30% of estimated cost
Activity chart/plan; self-assessing technical evaluation sheet
notes: Re-invitation of bids. Extract of pages 3-7 of a 107-page tender document (Section I NIT only); no BOQ. Bid download/submission 22/11/2022 18:00 to 06/12/2022 15:00; bid opening 07/12/2022 16:00. Listing bid_opening 2022-11-22 is actually the publication date.
